steps.en: Install the control center and start the local stack
steps.zh: 装上控制台，启动本地整套服务

steps.en: Starts the UI, an Agent Server and the automation backend behind one port
steps.zh: 在同一个端口后面拉起界面、Agent Server 和自动化后端

steps.en: Open the UI, pick an agent and give it a model key or reuse its CLI login
steps.zh: 打开界面，选一个 agent，填模型 key 或沿用它命令行的登录

steps.en: Start a conversation on a project folder and describe the task
steps.zh: 在某个项目目录上开一个对话，把任务说清楚

steps.en: Runs the agent on that backend: it edits files and runs shell commands
steps.zh: 在选定的后端上跑 agent：改文件、执行命令

steps.en: Streams chat, terminal and file changes back to the same UI for you to review
steps.zh: 把对话、终端输出和文件改动实时推回同一个界面，等你审

value.en: One browser tab drives every agent on every machine, instead of a terminal per agent per host
value.zh: 一个浏览器标签页就能驱动各台机器上的各个 agent，不用每个 agent 每台机器各开一个终端

sources: https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/blob/main/docs/SELF_HOSTING.md (ingress proxy fronting static server, agent server and automation backend)
https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/blob/main/docs/ACP_AGENTS.md (pick OpenHands or an ACP agent; subscription login or API key)
https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/blob/main/docs/architecture.md (Agent Canvas renders conversation, terminal, files; Agent Server executes)
